Which entries of $A$ could be replaced by $0$ in order to get a matrix in row echelon form?

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}5 & 0 & 7 & 4 \\ -2 & 0 & -5 & -3 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that by replacing ${a}_{21}$, ${a}_{31}$, and ${a}_{33}$ with $0$, we get a matrix in row echelon form:

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}5 & 0 & 7 & 4 \\ -2 & 0 & -5 & -3 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\,⟶\,\begin{bmatrix}5 & 0 & 7 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -5 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}.
$$

The other options will not give us a matrix in row echelon form.
